# CEL Critical Power

> > CEL Critical Power delivers IEC/UL certified power distribution solutions for AI infrastructure, data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, and critical applications worldwide.

CEL Critical Power is a global engineering and manufacturing company specializing in critical power infrastructure, including power distribution units (PDUs), switchgear, and packaged substations. With offices in Ireland, the United States, and India, CEL serves major clients like Bristol Myers Squibb and Pfizer while powering the AI revolution with advanced data center solutions.

## Key Topics

- Critical Power Infrastructure
- Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- IEC/UL Certified Solutions
- Data Center Power
- AI Infrastructure
- Switchgear & Substations
- Pharmaceutical Power Solutions
- Global Operations (Ireland, USA, India)
- Engineering & Manufacturing
- Energy Efficiency
- Motor Control Centers
- Bristol Myers Squibb Projects
- Pfizer Projects
- Mission-Critical Applications
- Power Distribution Systems
